 "description": "Explores the use of embedded computers for designing interactive audio applications. Begins with a programming primer and transitions to programming audio applications using an industry standard language, focusing on transferring skills acquired in visual programming environments to embedded/low-level programming concepts. Key topics include low-latency real-time audio synthesis and processing, physical computing, sensor integration, and basic electronics.
